text: {"fixes":[{"element_id":"s29.e09","problem":"The italic bold newsletter line is 363.2 wide where the real one is 356.9, so its text drifts right. It is about 1.8% too wide, and 0.6px too short in height.","fix":"Narrow the bold-italic run by ~1.8%: reduce letter-spacing by about 0.1px or font-size by ~0.2px so the line ends at x≈376.7. Set line-height to 24px so the box is 43px tall with y=721.5. Apply the same change to s30.e09 and s31.e07."},{"element_id":"s29.e11","problem":"The blue 'EW Dispatch newsletter' link is 344.8 wide vs 339.8 and starts 0.4px too low. e12 is a duplicate with the same error. The real link is also a slightly different blue and looks bolder.","fix":"Shrink the link run to 339.8 wide by using the same reduced bold-italic sizing as the preceding text. Set its box y=745.5, h=43. Apply the same to e12, and to s30.e11/e12 and s31.e09/e10. Use #1a73e8-like blue (#0f6fff) as in the real screen."},{"element_id":"s29","problem":"The hero photo shows a gray strip at the left (x20 to 40) because the art is placed at x=40 only. The real photo spans x20 to 391.","fix":"Draw assets/s29.e01.art.png at its rect (x40,y0,w371.4,h168.3) and fill x20-40 with the same photo, extending it under the back button. Do not leave a flat gray block."},{"element_id":"s30","problem":"A dark 'U' shaped fragment appears at the top of the mock, y0-25, instead of the real image bottom (a dark green and pendant crop). The heatmap is red there.","fix":"Clip the hero image container to y<=25 and position the photo so its bottom edge, including the necklace/pendant, matches the real one. Use the same photo crop as s29 shifted up by the scroll offset (135px)."},{"element_id":"s29","problem":"Paragraph text is 1px off vertically and slightly wider than the real text, so the heatmap is red over all the body text. Line breaks match but glyphs drift right by 1-6px along each line.","fix":"Lower the body font tracking (letter-spacing about -0.1px) and shift the body text down 1px. Do the same on s30 and s31."},{"element_id":"s12","problem":"The title and byline sit about 1px off from the real text. The Temu ad thumbnail is a flat stand-in (three flat blocks) instead of the real jacket collage with '$2.36'. The ad title is bolder than the real one.","fix":"Move the title and 'Sasha Wayman' byline 1px lower. Reduce title letter-spacing slightly so 'Kristi Noem Files for Divorce' ends at x≈351. Draw the ad thumbnail as the real jacket collage at x≈32,y≈257,w≈61,h≈60. Make the ad title weight 500."}],"summary":"The mock scores 8.94 with all taps working and no contract errors. The main remaining misses are the newsletter line and link runs on s29 to s31, which are 5-6px too wide. This round should fix those widths, the hero photo strip on s29 and the wrong crop on s30, and reduce the 1px vertical text offsets."}
